title: Verification-first diagnostic escalation feasibility (sequential V -> X repair)
config_version: stage_b_v8 (amendments A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7)
_format_note: JSON (standard library only), like Stage A.
oracle_status: Stage B uses TWO oracle components: (1) the gold answer decides whether Stage 1 failed and therefore whether escalation is triggered; (2) L_true / N_true use the expert-annotated first-error step. Stage B is NOT a deployable system; it asks whether diagnostic escalation has potential value IF failure detection and localisation were available.

limitations.test_source_contamination: Researcher decision 2026-10-12: using GSM8K-test / MATH-test source problems is acceptable for this feasibility study. Qwen3-4B may have seen these problems (or solutions) in training. Absolute accuracy / repair rates must NOT be interpreted as uncontaminated capability; the study's quantities of interest are paired, within-item differences between feedback conditions.

protocol_amendments.wording: A separate manual Pass-2 review is no longer required. For the 61 items whose ProcessBench first-error step k the human reviewer marked CONFIRM in the frozen Pass 1, that judgment already asserts that Step k is the EARLIEST substantive error; all preceding steps, including the predetermined false-location candidate f = k-1, were therefore implicitly judged not to contain an earlier substantive error. A separate Pass-2 human recheck is waived for feasibility because it would duplicate the same reviewer's earlier judgment. Stage-2 true-location analyses use only the 61 Pass-1 CONFIRM items. L_false uses only those 61 items and the frozen candidate f = k-1; its validity is labelled 'Pass-1-implied false-step validity', NOT independently Pass-2-validated. The 15 DISAGREE items are not used in the primary Stage-2 analysis (excluded from Stage 2 in all conditions; the reviewer's alternative step is recorded only and never substituted). The frozen Pass-1 files and hashes are preserved unchanged and Pass 1 is not reopened. The primary endpoint is unchanged: paired rescue difference V -> L_true vs V -> V.

parser.version: stage_b_numeric_v1 (FINAL_ANSWER field > terminal \boxed{}; pilot strict 2.0 diagnostic)
hierarchy: a: the LAST explicit FINAL_ANSWER: label field must contain exactly one standalone number (pilot field rule); label present -> no fallback; truncated generation whose field runs to end of text -> truncated_field

b: only if no label: terminal answer region only (text after the last 'final answer' phrase within the last 6 non-empty lines, else the last paragraph); accept exactly one distinct numeric value from properly closed \boxed{} answers (normalised like the gold answers)
c: the reasoning body is never searched; bare numbers are never taken
d: an unclosed \boxed{ in the terminal region (e.g. truncated '\boxed{90') -> incomplete_boxed (unparseable)
e: multiple incompatible candidate answers in the terminal region -> ambiguous (unparseable)
f: strict_format_compliant comes only from the frozen pilot strict parser; fallback parsing never makes a response strictly compliant
parser._note: Frozen by amendment A1; src/parser.py is registered in data/manifests/FROZEN_HASHES.json and its sha256 is recorded in every run manifest.

stage_a_link._note: Stage A is FROZEN. Stage B only READS these two Stage-A files (sha-verified) to confirm the solver identity; it never imports Stage-A code at run time and never writes into Stage A.

vendored_from_stage_a._note: Byte-for-byte logic copies (adapted imports/paths only). The sha256 is of the Stage-A source file at copy time.

pilot_link._note: Frozen pilot files Stage B imports or reads (sha-verified before use, read-only). Same hashes as Stage A records.

gsm8k_reference._note: ProcessBench has NO reference-answer field. GSM8K-split gold answers come from the GSM8K TEST split (text after '####'), matched by whitespace-normalised exact problem text. The file is the pilot's frozen copy (pilot_link data/raw/test.jsonl).

math_reference._note: MATH-split gold answers come from the Hendrycks MATH TEST split: last \boxed{...} of the reference solution, matched by whitespace-normalised exact problem text. Fetched as JSON through the HF datasets-server rows API (parquet loading is blocked on this machine by Windows Application Control). The rows API serves the dataset's current revision; the parquet files of the pinned revision are kept for provenance and the rows dump is cross-checked against MATH-500's 'answer' field where the two overlap.

dataset._domains_note: OlympiadBench and Omni-MATH are inspected and counted but not used: their reference answers are mostly symbolic/proof-style, outside the frozen numeric parser, and their traces are long (truncation risk). Using them would need an LLM judge or a symbolic checker.
dataset._selection_note: Researcher decision 2026-10-12 (before any Stage-B model output): Stage 1 uses ALL eligible items (no 100/100 sampling, no reserve). Domain (gsm8k/math), MATH level and MATH subject are kept for stratified SECONDARY analysis.
dataset._selection_seed_note: Now only fixes the within-domain listing order of the pool and the one-item-per-problem tie-break.
dataset.reserve_policy: No reserve: every eligible item is in the Stage-1 pool. If the failure gate is not met, no further eligible ProcessBench items exist under the frozen rules.
dataset._max_trace_chars_note: Keeps Stage-2 prompts (problem + trace + Stage-1 response) well inside the model context and limits very long traces; applied before selection, never based on model outcomes.

solver._overrides_note: Every other setting is the frozen pilot protocol (FP16, cuda:0, greedy, enable_thinking false, batch 1, one user message, no system prompt). max_new_tokens is re-checked by the fresh Stage-B truncation smoke test; any change needs researcher approval BEFORE full Stage-1 inference and is then frozen for Stage 1 AND Stage 2. Amendment A1 (approved 2026-10-12, after the smoke1 NO-GO: 6/20 truncated at 768): 768 -> 1536 for Stage 1 and Stage 2. Amendment A2 (approved 2026-10-13, after the smoke2 NO-GO on headroom only: sb_math-150 truncated at 1536, sb_math-7 at 1422 > 1382.4): 1536 -> 2048 for Stage 1 and Stage 2.

smoke._note: Deterministic selection: the 4 items with the longest rendered Stage-1 prompt (truncation probe), then alternating gsm8k/math in execution order to 20. Gate (researcher decision 2026-10-12): GO if >= 19/20 parse numerically AND no persistent technical failure AND no hash/prompt mismatch AND no truncation AND no response > 90% of max_new_tokens (technical checks: completion, resume, determinism, canary, no visible thinking). REVIEW if 18/20 parse and every other check passes. NO-GO if < 18/20 parse or any technical / truncation / headroom failure. Unparseable outputs are observed outcomes and are never regenerated.

failure_gate._note: Pre-specified. >= 50 Stage-1 failures -> Stage 2 may proceed (after researcher approval). < 50 -> Stage 2 is NOT analysed as adequately powered; report the count and the number of additional source items needed at the observed failure rate.

smoke._note: 3 genuine Stage-1 failures (that passed annotation review) x conditions = up to 12 requests; prefer the longest Stage-1 response. Same gate structure as Stage 1: GO <= 1 unparsed, REVIEW 2, NO-GO > 2 or any technical / truncation / headroom failure.
smoke._note_A7: Since A7 (2026-10-14) the Stage-2 smoke gate decides on pipeline / integrity criteria only: technical + persistence checks must pass; a response reaching the frozen 2048-token cap that completed normally and was persisted correctly is genuine model behaviour (a failed repair if no valid final answer parses), not a NO-GO; cap hits / >90% headroom are reported descriptively; the parse thresholds apply to responses that finished normally (finish_reason stop). The v9 NO-GO (pre-A7 gate) is preserved and never rescored.

stage2._false_step_note: L_false points at Step (k-1): the step immediately before the annotated first error. ProcessBench annotators judged every step before the first error correct, so this is a genuinely correct, pre-error step (never a downstream propagated step).

optional_one_shot_references._note: Supported by the prompt builder (single-shot prompts, no Stage-1 context) but NOT in the request grid unless enabled here with researcher approval.

annotation_review._note: Blinded annotation-fidelity gate between Stage 1 and Stage 2 (researcher decision 2026-10-12). After the Stage-1 failure set is frozen and hashed, ONLY the failed items are exported for manual review WITHOUT any Stage-1 model response or Stage-1 outcome. The reviewer verifies (a) the annotated first-error step and (b) that the proposed false step is genuinely correct. Decisions are frozen and hashed BEFORE Stage-2 prompts are built. Stage-2 outcomes are never used for exclusions.
annotation_review._false_step_verdicts_note_A6: PASS1_IMPLIED / NOT_REVIEWED exist only for the A6 Pass-1-only review (scripts/21): PASS1_IMPLIED = no separate Pass-2 judgment; f = k-1 is implied valid because the same reviewer's frozen Pass 1 CONFIRMED k as the earliest substantive error ('Pass-1-implied false-step validity', NOT independently Pass-2-validated). NOT_REVIEWED = item not CONFIRMED in Pass 1 (excluded from Stage 2 anyway).

pass2_waiver_A6.statement: A separate Pass-2 human recheck was waived for feasibility (amendment A6) because it would duplicate the same reviewer's earlier Pass-1 judgment: a Pass-1 CONFIRM of Step k as the earliest substantive error implies that every preceding step, including the false-location candidate f = k-1, contains no earlier substantive error.
pass2_waiver_A6.primary_set: the Pass-1 CONFIRM items only (61 of 76); the 15 DISAGREE items are excluded from the primary Stage-2 analysis

decision_rules.primary_stage2_set: Stage-1 failures whose first_error_verdict == CONFIRM. Items with DISAGREE/UNCLEAR are excluded from Stage 2 entirely (all conditions, so pairing is preserved); a reviewer-suggested alternative step is recorded but NEVER used to re-point L_true/N_true.
decision_rules.l_false: Built only for primary-set items whose false_step_verdict == CORRECT; otherwise the item is ineligible ONLY for L_false.
decision_rules.l_false_A6: Since A6: built for primary-set items whose false_step_verdict is in l_false_eligible_verdicts (CORRECT or PASS1_IMPLIED); with the Pass-1-only review every CONFIRM item is PASS1_IMPLIED.
decision_rules.below_min: If fewer than min_primary_items items pass review, STOP and report (Stage-2 build needs an explicit researcher override).

human_review.log: append-only JSONL per pass (pass1_log.jsonl / pass2_log.jsonl); every save is a new line with UTC saved_at, the time the item was opened, the sha256 of the item view shown, and the sha256 of the previous line (hash chain); the current judgment of an item is its last line; earlier lines (revisions) are never deleted
human_review._pass2_waiver_note: Pass 2 was waived by amendment A6 (see annotation_review.pass2_waiver_A6); scripts 19 / 20 refuse --pass 2; decisions come from scripts/21_freeze_pass1_only_review.py.
human_review.blinding_limitation: blinding is procedural for a human: the reviewer must not open stage_b_items.json, the A3 annotation_review_packet.md / form (they show the annotated step) or any Stage-1 / LLM-review file until both passes are frozen

interpretation_rule.status: FROZEN by researcher decision 2026-10-12 before any Stage-B model output (lock: data/manifests/INTERPRETATION_RULE_FROZEN.json)
interpretation_rule.population: primary Stage-2 set = frozen Stage-1 failures that passed the blinded annotation review
interpretation_rule.delta: Delta_rescue = Rescue(V->L_true) - Rescue(V->V), paired; 95% CI = paired bootstrap percentile interval (analysis.bootstrap_resamples, analysis.bootstrap_seed)
interpretation_rule.STRONG: CI lower bound > 0 AND point estimate >= +0.10
interpretation_rule.diagnostic_content_contrast: V->L_true vs V->L_false is reported as a SEPARATE paired contrast (same statistics); it does not enter the label.
interpretation_rule.not_in_label: False-location gain, truncation/parse robustness and domain subgroups are reported as secondary/sensitivity analyses only.
